## Key Concepts

### R
- Packages: "dplyr" and "tidycensus"
- tibble --> verb --> tibble
- filter() --> pick rows
- select() --> pick columns
- mutate() --> modify dataframe (add new columns, summarize, etc.)
- arrange() --> change order of rows (ascending/descending)
- group_by/summarize() --> reduce rows
- pipe (%>% or |>) can group functions

### Census
- Decennial census: 10 years, 10 questions
- American Community Survey (ACS): ~2005 born, ~3% of households, every year + 5 year average
- state --> county --> tract --> block groups --> block
- M = margin of error
- E = estimate
